stem: Bailey and Dylan each had pies that were the same size. Bailey ate \( \frac{1}{3} \) of his pie. Dylan ate \( \frac{1}{4} \) of his pie. Which statement is true?

options.label: F
options.text: The boys ate the same amount of pie, because both fractions have a numerator of 1.

options.label: G
options.text: Bailey ate more pie, because each slice of a pie cut into 3 equal parts is larger than each slice of a pie cut into 4 equal parts.

options.label: H
options.text: Dylan ate more pie, because a denominator of 4 is larger than a denominator of 3.

options.label: J
options.text: There is not enough information to determine who ate more pie.

difficulty_rationale: The problem requires understanding of fractions and comparing fractional parts with different denominators, which involves modest reasoning beyond direct recall.
